🚨TAKE A LOOK🚨

Ilhan Omar’s staff allegedly changed her  birthdate in public records AFTER she was elected to Congress in 2018. 

She’s accused of misrepresenting her age to obtain U.S. citizenship. 

The director of the Minnesota Legislative Reference Library wrote that library staff were told by Rep. Omar’s congressional staff that her birth year was incorrect and were asked to revise it to 1982. 

Omar received derivative citizenship through her father, Nur Omar Mohamed, who she said became a naturalized citizen in 2000—five years after arriving in the United States.
